ABOUT US

Building a platform where compassion meets action. We believe in creating a more humane society through technology and community.

Mission

No Favouritism

We stand for equality and justice. Our platform is designed to amplify voices that deserve to be heard, without bias or preference. Everyone deserves a fair chance to share their story.

Vision

Social Change Through Technology

We envision a world where technology serves humanity's highest ideals. By connecting compassionate individuals, we create ripples of positive change that extend far beyond the digital realm.

ZD

Our Story

Social Factory was born from a simple yet powerful belief: that great compassion can transform society. In a world often divided by differences, we chose to focus on what unites us all – our shared humanity and our capacity for kindness.

Founded in 2026, we've dedicated ourselves to supporting those who suffer physically or face injustice. Our platform serves as a bridge between those who need help and those who want to make a difference.

Every feature we build, every story we share, and every connection we facilitate is guided by our core principle: No Favouritism. We believe in treating every voice with equal respect and every cause with genuine care.
